subject.title: Gateway silently skips channel initialization on plugin/runtime mismatch or missing module files

question: What startup contract should OpenClaw use when a configured channel plugin fails before it registers a runtime channel?
rationale: Current code can diagnose plugin failures through plugin/status surfaces, but deciding whether gateway startup should warn-and-continue, fail fast on compatibility mismatch, trigger restart/reload, or split those behaviors changes operator-visible startup semantics.

options.title: Add A Configured-Channel Startup Audit
options.body: Emit a startup summary for configured channel ids that were attempted, loaded, or failed before registration, without changing restart or hot-reload behavior in the same fix.

options.title: Fail Fast On Incompatible Plugins
options.body: Treat selected plugin/core version mismatches as startup-blocking errors, accepting the upgrade-compatibility risk explicitly.

options.title: Split Reload And Performance Work
options.body: Keep this issue focused on diagnostics and track hot reload, plugin metadata caching, and external API timeout severity as separate design items.

recommendation.title: Add A Configured-Channel Startup Audit
recommendation.body: Emit a startup summary for configured channel ids that were attempted, loaded, or failed before registration, without changing restart or hot-reload behavior in the same fix.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining decision crosses plugin loader diagnostics and channel discovery ownership, where recent path history points most strongly to vincentkoc.
